create.name: Éowyn Ahlstrom
create.bio:
Éowyn Ahlstrom is an insight meditation teacher who lives and works in Barre, Massachusetts, the small town that is home to the Insight Meditation Society. She came to meditation through yoga during a decade of travel after university, then found her way back to the vipassana and metta practice being taught on her doorstep. Over some twenty years she sat many retreats at IMS and the Forest Refuge, worked there as staff and volunteer, and was later authorised to teach by the IMS guiding teachers following a period of mentoring with Greg Scharf, Kamala Masters and Bhikkhu Analayo.

Alongside the dharma she has a long background in mindfulness-based programmes, having trained MBSR teachers at Brown University and taught for the mindfulness centres at UMass Medical School and Cambridge Health Alliance. Her own practice, Middle Path Healing Arts, brings together sitting meditation, mindful movement drawn from yoga and qigong, and down-to-earth reflection on early Buddhist teachings. She leads a weekly insight group on Zoom and in Barre, a monthly online membership of recorded practices, individual guidance and silent retreats. She is also a poet, and her collection Mindscapes: Practice Poems gathers pieces written on and around retreat.

books.title: Mindscapes: Practice Poems
books.author: Éowyn Ahlstrom
books.description: A short collection of poems by a long-time meditation and yoga practitioner, many of them written during or just after silent retreats. The pieces dwell on small moments of noticing in nature and everyday life, and can be read slowly as a support for practice.

courses.title: Mindfulness as the Gateway to Many Beautiful Qualities
courses.description: A five-day IMS Online retreat co-taught with Bob Stahl, built around silent sitting and walking, guided movement and talks. It looks at how steady attention opens into kindness, compassion, joy and equanimity, and suits newcomers as well as people involved in mindfulness-based programmes.

courses.title: Online Practice Membership
courses.description: A monthly online membership with recorded guided meditations, reflections, gentle yoga sessions, talks and worksheets, added to each month. A higher tier adds a live monthly practice group with Éowyn on Zoom.
courses.price: $14 USD a month (Do It Yourself) or $39 USD a month (Practice Together)

courses.title: Individual Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one guidance in meditation and mindful yoga, booked singly or in packs of three, six or twelve. Sessions are shaped around the student's own practice and questions.

free_resources.title: Insight Meditation Weekly
free_resources.description: A weekly sitting group on Tuesday evenings with a guided meditation followed by a talk and discussion on early Buddhist themes such as generosity, ethics and lovingkindness. It meets on Zoom and in Barre and runs on voluntary contributions.

free_resources.title: Mindful Movement Weekly
free_resources.description: A Saturday morning online class of gentle movement drawn from hatha yoga, viniyoga and qigong, with attention on breath and sensation. It is offered freely, with donations welcome.
